arthur_blackwood.name: Arthur Blackwood
arthur_blackwood.description: Founder and CEO of Blackwood Industries. Highly wealthy but had many deep conflicts with his family and business partners.

eleanor_blackwood.name: Eleanor Blackwood
eleanor_blackwood.description: Arthur's wife of 30 years. Quiet, elegant, and strangely detached from the tragedy. Claims she was reading in the library all evening.

unhappy_marriage.description: Eleanor was planning to divorce Arthur. She was cut out of the new will draft.

daniel_blackwood.name: Daniel Blackwood
daniel_blackwood.description: Arthur's son. He has a history of reckless behavior and massive gambling debts. Argued loudly with Arthur yesterday.

gambling_debts.description: Daniel owes $2M to underground bookies. He desperately needed Arthur's inheritance.

sophia_blackwood.name: Sophia Blackwood
sophia_blackwood.description: An avant-garde artist. Arthur was disapproving of her lifestyle and threatened to stop funding her studio.

forged_art.description: Sophia forged Arthur's signature to sell family art pieces to support her lifestyle.

james_holloway.name: James Holloway
james_holloway.description: The loyal butler who has served the Blackwood family for 25 years. Knows the mansion layout intimately. Claims he was prepping tea in the kitchen.

hallway_presence.description: James was near the study around 10:00 PM, despite claiming he never left the kitchen.

olivia_reed.name: Olivia Reed
olivia_reed.description: The nervous housekeeper. She claims she saw someone sneak toward the study around 10 PM but refuses to name them.

fearful_witness.description: Olivia saw Victor Hayes near the study, but Victor threatened her job and safety.

victor_hayes.name: Victor Hayes
victor_hayes.description: Arthur's business partner and CFO. Highly polished, corporate executive. Claims he spent the entire night at his suburban residence.

embezzlement.description: Victor embezzled $5M from company funds and Arthur discovered it right before his death.

detective_harris.name: Detective Harris
detective_harris.description: The lead police investigator assigned to the case. Cynical and impatient. Insists Arthur committed suicide and wants to wrap up the investigation.
